scope: Verified immutable Windows bundles hosted through the existing agent API; automatic declared Runtime/Native AOT loading, same-owner shared player/UI/settings/checkpoint observation.

contracts.authority: Shared native PlayerPreferences outside authored worlds, input profiles and gameplay saves.
contracts.publication: One prepared patch per whole Control/step boundary; publish only after complete native success, before queued storage/replacement. Failed boundaries consume no preference revision or ticket.
contracts.observations: Committed configuration and sparse sources are distinct from cached observed/applied/presented device state; samples/frame slots remain next-launch intent.
contracts.availability: Named host support is separate from an attached owner. Stop clears availability; new player creates an independent owner; replay rejects mutation.

api_changes.capability: game_runtime_service is enabled when simulation is compiled
api_changes.inspection: Optional input_profile in game.inspect, relative to bundle root
api_changes.host: Existing owner-thread shared headless transport/pump and guards; no new action driver.

checks: Actual MCP initialization, notification barrier, ping/catalog and tools share the CLI native session; readonly rejection preserves identical text/structured error content and closing MCP detaches cleanly.
Relocated source-free bundle starts native simulation at authored revision and tick0 without a player; queries/profile reads share the authoritative session.
Endpoint collision rejects before accessing a missing game manifest and leaves the existing owner intact.
Authoring, input/settings writes and development methods reject; save protection includes runtime directories outside the content folder.
Real native controller step survives detach/reconnect; exact receipt retry does not advance and changed/stale requests reject.
External save captures tick12; actual replacement restores exact controller state and an exact Load retry is inert; full bundle bytes remain unchanged.
Clean shutdown releases the endpoint; restart creates a fresh tick0 native session without inherited save configuration.
Malformed argv, nonexistent/inside-bundle save roots, malformed/duplicate/version/hash/extra-file bundles reject without writes; endpoint remains reusable.

Game bundles require a simulation and renderer runtime.

no_window_contract.mcp: Full initialize + initialized notification + ping + tools/list + three poima_call tools; same session, read-only description and -32081 mutation rejection.

retained_failed_attempts.reason: Five suites passed, then project_contract rejected the launcher-only --binary argument (exit2), before executing that suite. Correct positional argument and remaining suites are recorded separately; passed suites were not repeated.

limitations: Bounded fixtures on one laptop; no whole Alpha or complete game-scale qualification.
Semantic shared API/compiled UI controls, not physical input or OS pointer hit testing.
Audio disabled in compiled cohorts: gain configuration, not sink/listening qualification.
Source removal and sanitized development-host launches are not clean-machine deployment tests.
One same-player checkpoint replacement per compiled cohort; no fresh-process compiled settings/save continuation or preference persistence claim.
Current game bundles require simulation and renderer runtimes. Linux headless builds pass selected regressions, but Linux native bundles/rendering are not newly qualified.
Elapsed times are execution records, not production performance measurements.
The public PNG exactly matches NVIDIA after-load RGB. AMD has independently checked menu pixels; cross-GPU exact full-image equality is not claimed.

public_capture.comparison: NVIDIA .83 service after-load renderer BMP matches lossless PNG RGB exactly; existing image reused.
